name: P-326 CUSTOMER-IDENTITY-P326 live boundary check: a hosted claude New Session on avi-test r60 runs a metadata-only check script through its own shell tool, reporting its OS identity, process ancestry, supervisor identity, HOME credential resolution, workspace access and denied protected reads
command: PROBE_MODE=launch PROBE_AGENT=claude PROBE_SETTLE_MS=100000 PROBE_TEXT='Please run this command in your shell: bash ~/p326-boundary-check.sh  -- then reply with the single VERDICT line it prints.' npx tsx .papercusp/scratch/wi10003163-chat-probe.mts e91577da-655b-4b24-b122-ab57b4f9d211 ws-3daf37098c8096b5d9e0ac72 host-3daf37098c8096b5d9e0ac72
summary: A claude New Session launched on avi-test r60 through the portal operator-http relay (connector ticket issued by the control plane, broker :3880) executed ~/p326-boundary-check.sh with its own Bash tool and replied 'VERDICT uid_customer=yes denied=12/12 env_cred_nonempty=1' (advSession 20; advSession 19 at 14:24Z gave the same identity and 12/12 denials). The agent runs as papercusp-workspace uid 1001 with HOME /home/papercusp-workspace; its ancestry is bash(1001) <- claude(1001) <- sshd(1001) <- sshd(root); the supervising psu.mjs and its 'ssh -tt' hop run as the service user papercusp uid 999 under serve.mjs r60. Customer-home credential files (.claude/.credentials.json, .claude.json, .codex/auth.json) are owned by papercusp-workspace mode 600. The agent can create/read/remove files in its workspace (HOME). All 12 protected targets are denied: /var/lib/papercusp (service runtime + embedded PG data), /var/lib/papercusp/.papercusp, /opt/papercusp (release bytes), /home/papercusp-agent and its .claude/.credentials.json and .codex/auth.json (service agent credentials), /var/lib/papercusp-desktop, /home/ubuntu, /etc/shadow, /var/lib/papercusp/.papercusp/superuser-token; two Google OS Login homes do not exist on disk. Credential-shaped env names present in the agent are all empty (len=0), blanked by the launcher's --settings overlay (psu-launcher.mjs CLAUDE_DEFAULT_AUTH_ENV_KEYS -> ''); the single non-empty one, CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_TOKEN (32 chars), is Claude Code's own per-session local message-socket token (present in the claude binary beside CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET; not set by any Papercusp source), not a service credential. The check prints metadata only, never file contents or values. Single-tenant host: no second customer workspace exists, so the foreign-workspace read is exercised against the other accounts' homes on the box.

assertions.evidence: SELF_ID uid=1001(papercusp-workspace) gid=1002(papercusp-workspace) groups=1002(papercusp-workspace); SELF_HOME /home/papercusp-workspace; result file owned by papercusp-workspace (written by the agent process).
ANCESTRY bash 1001 <- bash 1001 <- claude 1001 <- MainThread 1001 <- sshd 1001 <- sshd root <- sshd root (pid 1695 <- 1).

SUPERVISOR_PS: serve.mjs r60 (uid 999 papercusp) -> bash -lc -> scripts/psu.mjs --no-picker --agent=claude (uid 999) -> /usr/bin/ssh -F /dev/null -tt -i /var/lib/papercusp/hosted-pty-ssh/id_ed25519 (uid 999) -> claude (uid 1001).
HOME_CRED papercusp-workspace 600 for ~/.claude/.credentials.json, ~/.claude.json, ~/.codex/auth.json; the session authenticated and replied using them.
WORKSPACE_RW allowed papercusp-workspace (create, read back, remove in HOME).

VERDICT denied=12/12: Permission denied for /var/lib/papercusp, /var/lib/papercusp/.papercusp, /opt/papercusp, /home/papercusp-agent, /var/lib/papercusp-desktop, /home/ubuntu, /home/papercusp-agent/.claude/.credentials.json, /home/papercusp-agent/.codex/auth.json, /var/lib/papercusp/.papercusp/superuser-token, /etc/shadow; two Google OS Login account homes (listed in passwd, never created on disk) returned No such file.

ENV_CRED_NAME len=0 for ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_OAUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN(_FILE), ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_AUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_AWS_API_KEY, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN; only CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_TOKEN len=32 (Claude Code's own session-local socket token).
